scope: Recorded-time eligibility, legacy experimental cache repair, and real local usage regression

defect.classification: Confirmed product logic inconsistency, not a build or environment failure
defect.before: A future recorded turn could enter tokens but not activity; unchanged-file reuse then permanently skipped its activity witness. Clock rollback also exposed cached future tokens.
defect.finalFollowUp: Expanded the legacy-cache case to cover unavailable reread, deferred activity import and later successful retry. Both tokens and imported activity require recordedAt <= record.observedAt.

invariants: Future-dated new turn revisions are quarantined without replacing last good values
The five-minute sourceUpdatedAt metadata allowance does not grant future turn eligibility
Timestamp quarantine is retried with existing bounded backoff even when the fingerprint is unchanged
Clock rollback hides future token/model buckets but retains their UTC source ledger
Legacy premature cache data is not validated merely by wall-clock time passing
Unavailable source revalidation leaves legacy premature tokens and activity missing
Successful source revalidation uses the same turn identity and repairs its activity witness
A repaired cache resumes the unchanged-source fast path without extra CLI calls or duplicate totals

appHostedFinal.overlap: The 47 integration and 18 derived cases also run in Foundation. The remaining 9 are legacy streak regressions.

earlierCombinedAppUIRun.scopeBoundary: Built before the final legacy-cache observedAt/import guard. Final guards covered by Foundation and app-hosted runs; no view code changed.

realLocalFinal.scopeBoundary: Real local usage only, not account quota, broad source-lineage coverage, actual Dock interaction or release packaging.

remaining: Safe official billing startup and authenticated quota evidence
Official terminal authentication controller and real auth lifecycle
Actual Dock interaction, machine sleep/wake and full keyboard/VoiceOver
Broader real source attribution and long-term retention stress
Full regression, standard launch and Developer ID/Hardened Runtime packaged validation
